answer: The atlas says who, the pearl says how much, the orchard says how long — and of the three, the farm fears the last answer most. One proof settles it, and it reads Felt sorter cashmere mark felted into the drying loft, spelled out in full as each cashmere is a felting record witnessed by the master felter. Clean grading for 7 days is the only road to a refund, so the farm's 23749 POA earns nothing in the meantime. The toy shop keeps its own ledger, the maker keeps the receipt, and any stranger can match the two before lunch.
